detail: The expected result 'There is still exactly one link in the primary navigation' is not in the story, which only requires the Shop all link's text, destination and look to be unchanged. Drop the assertion or limit it to 'exactly one link named Shop all'.

The precondition names item 99 but step 3 says 'click a product card's link' without naming which one. Name the card to click (for example item 99 'Adventurer GPS Watch' if it is on the first catalog page, or the first product card) and the exact URL path expected at step 4.

After clicking 'Shop all' the test asserts pathname '/', but neither the highlight keyframe nor the step keyframe after the click shows the 'After click: <url>' caption. The frames show the catalog grid with no URL, so the recording does not prove the destination (lesson L2).

Step 6 expects URL path '/'. The test asserts it, but keyframes 09 and 10 after the 'Shop all' click show the catalog hero without the 'Back on <url>' caption, so no frame shows the URL after the in-app navigation back.
